caption:
Gallup's 2026 data puts India's manager engagement down nine points since 2024 — the steepest decline globally, with overall engagement at a four-year low.

Read that alongside what's happening on calendars this week. 30 September closes H1 of the financial year. Mid-year reviews, H2 targets, half-year performance conversations.

Here is the part most people miss. Organisations have flattened. Fewer rungs, wider spans, more people reporting to you and no additional authority handed over with them. The title no longer carries the weight it used to.

So the weight has to come from somewhere else. Bearing. Tone. The silence you hold instead of filling.

In command, authority was never only positional. It was carried in how a man stood, what he said, and what he refused to say. That transfers directly to a review room.

The org chart used to do this work for you. It doesn't anymore.
